text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to reduce the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Dufferin Street, between Sheppard Avenue West and Clifton Avenue. The implementation of a 40 km/h speed limit on this roadway is warranted and will promote reduced travel speeds and provide a safer environment for cyclists and pedestrians, which includes students destined to/from a nearby secondary school.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Dufferin Street, between Sheppard Avenue West and Clifton Avenue.
